anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.ota_headline: De Zeekoe Guest Farm: Authentic Karoo Wildlife & Farm Stay in Oudtshoorn
anti_commodity_copy_rewrite.property_overview_150_words: Experience the heart of the Klein Karoo at De Zeekoe Guest Farm, a working farm just outside Oudtshoorn. Immerse yourself in nature with unique meerkat encounters at sunrise, relax by the sparkling outdoor pool with mountain views, and savor delicious farm-to-table cuisine. Our comfortable rooms offer a peaceful retreat, blending rustic charm with modern amenities. Enjoy warm, attentive service and discover the true spirit of South African hospitality. De Zeekoe is your gateway to exploring the Cango Caves, ostrich farms, and the serene beauty of the Karoo, offering an unforgettable escape for families, couples, and nature lovers.
